_comment: Pipeline settings (no secrets). enabled=false is the kill switch. testRecipient: if set, every email goes there with 【測試】 in the subject. Times are in timezone.
_includeFlaggedContacts: false (default): rows whose notes say 免費郵箱 / 可能為個人電郵 / 校長郵箱 are not emailed (status skipped_flagged; PDPO: may be personal mailboxes). true includes them; re-run import after changing.
_campaigns: Optional per-campaign content for ./emails/scripts/run.sh --reactivate --campaign <name>: { "<name>": { "templatesDir": "campaigns/<name>/templates", "topics": "campaigns/<name>/topics.json" } } (paths under emails/content/; omitted = default templates/topics).
